sentences.text:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar
---------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Sarju Prasad, Advocate For the Resps./State : Mr. Praveen Akhouri, S.C
(Mines)-I Mr. Aishwarya Prakash, A.C to S.C (Mines)-I
---------
 th
12/Dated: 11 September, 2024
1.
It appears that it is an admitted position that the land, in question, is a raiyati land.
There was a title suit between the raiyats, but it is not in dispute that the land has to be acquired.
2. It further appears that the land has actually been acquired and the Award has also been prepared.
Now, the factual matrix is required to be looked into "whether the old Land Acquisition Act, 1894 has lapsed or not?"

If it has lapsed, the petitioner is entitled for recalculation of the compensation amount under the new Act, i.e., the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement (RFCTLARR) Act, 2013.
3. For that purpose, learned counsel for the State seeks an adjournment.
